guidance.promptSnippet: Track progress when a task list is useful
promptGuidelines: Use todo when tracking substantial work or several deliverables would help. Skip it for ordinary conversation, interview practice, and simple tasks unless requested.
Keep task status accurate. Mark work completed only when its requested outcome is achieved; record blockers without claiming completion.
To change status, use update with id and status; include activeForm when marking in_progress. Use addBlockedBy/removeBlockedBy to update dependencies.
